given.note: A read that names Sam's code row, which has no business, so it runs on the runtime side. The row has no turn (K-04 v1.1 job row), so the read answers notFound (table outbox_rows) before any turn read, as a safety row answers fixedLineRow first, and returns nothing of it (README item 65; ADR-016 section 1). No caller names such a row: it is written checked and never goes stale.
